Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can scope the PoC and flag any security/procurement gates up front.

Recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: summarization + assisted coding for internal clinical review workflows
- Sensitive data class: PHI may be involved in some workflows (in-scope for controls)
- Expected ramp: pilot with 5–10 users, then potential org-wide in Q4 if latency & cost targets met

As discussed, could you share the following so we can prepare tailored compliance guidance and an accurate SOW?
1) Org topology: a simple org chart (file or PDF) showing the decision maker(s) and the person who signs contracts (legal/procurement contact).
2) Security contacts: name/email/role for the team that will run the security/compliance questionnaire (SOC2, data retention, KMS).
3) Procurement steps: procurement@novamed.com or internal process notes (Do you require an SOW, PO, or a vendor security review first?).
4) Decision criteria: top 3 metrics that will determine success (latency, cost per inference, fidelity/regulatory fit).

Suggested next steps / timeline:
- You share org chart + security point-of-contact by EOD Tue (16 Jun)
- We’ll draft a concise mutual action plan and a preliminary SOW template by Fri
- Quick intro meeting with our security engineer if required (15–30m)

If easier, feel free to forward this to procurement or legal and CC me — I can adapt the ask to match their intake format.

Thanks — Jordan
